output.scope_note: The paper is about the Na-ion solid electrolyte Na3.4Sc0.4Zr1.6(SiO4)2PO4 and reports measured bulk and grain-boundary ionic conductivities at room temperature.

records.evidence_quote: Facile Na ion exchange results in room-temperature ion conductivities of 2.0 mS/cm for Na3.4Sc0.4Zr1.6(SiO4)2PO4 and 1.0 mS/cm for the parent compound Na3Zr2(SiO4)2PO4, respectively.
records.notes: Bulk value at room temperature. Activation energy 0.29 eV is the d.c. bulk activation energy (Ea,d.c. = 0.29(1) eV) stated in the results text; the paper gives 0.29 to 0.31 eV for the overall transport. Composition written in the paper as Na3.4Sc0.4Zr1.6(SiO4)2PO4 and described as sol-gel prepared in the conclusions.

records.evidence_quote: Facile Na ion exchange results in room-temperature ion conductivities of 2.0 mS/cm for Na3.4Sc0.4Zr1.6(SiO4)2PO4 and 1.0 mS/cm for the parent compound Na3Zr2(SiO4)2PO4, respectively.
records.notes: Sc-free parent NZSP used as benchmark. Bulk value at room temperature; the text gives it as 1.0 mS/cm at 20 °C in the results section. Activation energy not stated in the text for this compound.

records.evidence_quote: At 20 °C the bulk conductivity of Na3Zr2(SiO4)2PO4 is 1.0 mS/cm, for σ′g.b. we found 0.7 mS/cm (Fig. 2b).
records.notes: Grain-boundary conductivity of the Sc-free parent NZSP at 20 °C, as stated in the results text and Fig. 2b caption (298 K).
